alt: Timeline of the Karmelo Anthony case from the April 2025 stabbing to the denied motion for a new trial
title: The Karmelo Anthony case so far

events.label: Austin Metcalf, 17, is stabbed at a track meet in Frisco
events.note: Anthony is arrested the same day and says he acted in self-defense

events.label: A Collin County jury convicts Anthony of murder
events.note: He is sentenced to 35 years in prison

events.label: Hearing on the motion for a new trial
events.note: Defense argues courtroom access and an evidence agreement violated his rights

events.label: Judge Michael Chitty denies the motion

next.label: The case moves to the Fifth Court of Appeals
